angle: Unlike other classification materials that discuss thresholds, ROC, or prevalence, this one computes sensitivity and specificity end to end on fixed tables, first binary across two classifiers and then per-category on a three-class table.
angle_detail: Start with [02:46]–[05:28] because the binary formulas plus the logistic-versus-forest comparison show how to read each rate directly off the table layout. Then work through [05:33]–[10:15] for the per-category method where each class gets its own rates from regrouped counts. Watch the layout convention that rows are predictions and columns are truth, and do not expect threshold tuning or predictive values here.
